import os,subprocess,objc
from PIL import Image
import wf as _w
def rss(): return int(subprocess.run(['ps','-o','rss=','-p',str(os.getpid())],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)//1024
Q=_w._quartz(); w=_w.require_window()
def cg():
    return Q.CGWindowListCreateImage(Q.CGRectNull,Q.kCGWindowListOptionIncludingWindow,w['id'],Q.kCGWindowImageBoundsIgnoreFraming|Q.kCGWindowImageNominalResolution)
def v_memview():
    with objc.autorelease_pool():
        c=cg(); d=Q.CGDataProviderCopyData(Q.CGImageGetDataProvider(c))
        im=Image.frombuffer('RGBA',(Q.CGImageGetWidth(c),Q.CGImageGetHeight(c)),memoryview(d),'raw','BGRA',Q.CGImageGetBytesPerRow(c),1).convert('RGB')
        del d,c
        return im
def v_context():
    with objc.autorelease_pool():
        c=cg(); W_,H_=Q.CGImageGetWidth(c),Q.CGImageGetHeight(c)
        buf=bytearray(W_*H_*4)
        ctx=Q.CGBitmapContextCreate(buf,W_,H_,8,W_*4,Q.CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB(),Q.kCGImageAlphaPremultipliedLast|Q.kCGBitmapByteOrderDefault)
        Q.CGContextDrawImage(ctx,Q.CGRectMake(0,0,W_,H_),c)
        del ctx,c
        return Image.frombuffer('RGBA',(W_,H_),bytes(buf),'raw','RGBA',0,1).convert('RGB')
for name,f in [('memoryview(CopyData)',v_memview),('bitmap context',v_context)]:
    f(); r=rss()
    for _ in range(10): f()
    print(f'{name:22s} +{(rss()-r)/10:.1f} MB/call')
